verdict.rationale: End-to-end testing tooling is a fair axis for a UI framework, but the evidence pack has nothing on official E2E testing tools or test-runner integration with the dev server. It only mentions Vite ecosystem integration in general terms, which is a host-platform/adjacent capability, not an official testing tool.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate official end-to-end testing tools that work out of the box with the framework's dev server
